items.summary: 美元指數10月升至2025年5月來高位，今年來漲約3.45%，因通膨偏強、Fed恐重啟升息與AI資金流入 Fed週三按兵不動，但主席華許偏鷹；華爾街多家機構撤回看空，CFTC顯示美元多頭部位近400億美元 期中選舉與中東局勢牽動美元，市場認為短期由通膨與Fed定調，中期看AI投資，長期看伊朗與油價

items.title: Asia stocks tumble as AI spending concerns deepen; BOJ holds rates
items.summary: Investing.com-- Asian stocks tumbled on Friday, with artificial intelligence-related shares leading losses after disappointing results from U.S. technology companies, while the Bank of Japan held interest rates steady as expected.
